agent_initiated_findings.title: Achievable range check — level gap risk for long horizons
agent_initiated_findings.findings: Fold 3 has a -3.7% level gap (train mean ~318 vs val mean ~306). Tree ensemble cannot predict values outside the training range. Validation falls within training range, so validation metric may be optimistic. If deployment period sees larger level shift than fold 3, range_ok on validation understates the risk.
agent_initiated_findings.reasoning: Training.md §8b: 'if Preprocess warned that validation sits closer to train than the unseen holdout, validation understates this failure.'

handoff.read_this_first: ML-as-regression (LightGBM) fitted for all 6 horizons. ALL horizons beat baseline floor — see beats_floor_by_horizon. model_paths_by_horizon.why: Diagnosis and end_model need these to load the champions for each horizon.

val_mae_by_horizon.why: Current champion MAEs; Diagnosis compares subsequent iterations against these.

beats_floor_by_horizon.why: Every model must beat its floor before being accepted.

achievable_range_by_horizon.why: Range failure → target representation fix required, not hyperparameter tuning.

ts_approach_gap.why: ARIMA family must be fitted once before run may stop (training.md §2b-ts).

hyperparameter_search_done.why: Training.md guardrail: defaults are a starting point; stop_check.py blocks without search.

durable_rules.rule: LightGBM models are saved per-horizon at artifacts/training/models/lgbm_h{h}.txt — load with lgb.Booster(model_file=path).
durable_rules.why: Both .pkl (joblib) and .txt (booster) saved; .txt is more portable for MLflow; .pkl for sklearn API.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Wrong model loaded for wrong horizon — silent error.

durable_rules.rule: Feature subset for each horizon is in horizon_feature_subsets[h]['feature_list'] in state/current.json.
durable_rules.why: Training used these exactly; inference must use the same columns.

methodological_cautions.caution: h=1 and h=7 use identical naive predictors (naive_h1/h7 smedian_w4/13/26 are mathematically identical for same-DOW targets) AND the same lag (bread_lag_7d). Their LightGBM models may be nearly identical. Diagnosis should verify whether a single model could serve both horizons.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Unnecessary model duplication; may obscure any real h=1 vs h=7 information difference.

methodological_cautions.caution: Permutation importance computed on val set (95 rows for most horizons). Standard errors may be high. Groups with importance < 1.0 MAE units should be treated as noisy.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Feature importance rankings at low importance levels are unreliable with n_val=95.

do_not_repeat.tried: Training one pooled model across all horizons
do_not_repeat.evidence: training.md §0: 'one model per active horizon — not one model scored at several lead times'
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: Long horizons dominated by short ones; h=30 model inherits h=1 features it won't have at its origin.
